clips.title: The story
paras: The Lorgalis Manuscript is an ancient text tied to the worship and lore of the Old Gods, preserved from the fallen night elven ruins beneath Ashenvale. Hidden within the sunken temple complex of Blackfathom Deeps, it holds secrets coveted by dark scholars seeking to awaken ancient, slumbering powers.

The Lorgalis Manuscript rests at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps, the sunken ruins where long-dead elves once dwelt before their city fell. Written by one Lorgalis, it speaks of the Old Gods who raged across Azeroth when the world was new and now lie chained and sleeping, and it praises Aku'mai, a servant of the Old Gods who dwells in the Deeps. Its lore is said to open mystical doorways and stir ancient entities that sleep deep beneath the world. Stored away in a pitted iron chest amidst the flooded corridors, it has drawn the attention of cultists and shadow scholars alike.
